pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface AggregatorV3Interface {
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
    function latestRoundData() external view
        returns (uint80, int256, uint256, uint256, uint80);
}
interface IERC20 {
    function transfer(address, uint256) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address, address, uint256) external returns (bool);
    function balanceOf(address) external view returns (uint256);
}

library AMMLib {
    error Liq();
    function price(uint256 rx, uint256 vy, uint256 ry) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return rx == 0 ? 0 : (vy + ry) / rx;
    }
    function buy(uint256 rx, uint256 vy, uint256 ry, uint256 ain)
        external pure returns (uint256 out, uint256 nrx, uint256 pB, uint256 pA)
    {
        uint256 oy = vy + ry;
        pB = rx > 0 ? oy / rx : 0;
        uint256 ny = oy + ain;
        nrx = (rx * oy) / ny;
        out = rx - nrx;
        if (out == 0 || out >= rx) revert Liq();
        pA = ny / nrx;
    }
    function sell(uint256 rx, uint256 vy, uint256 ry, uint256 ax)
        external pure returns (uint256 out, uint256 nrx, uint256 pB, uint256 pA)
    {
        uint256 ey = vy + ry;
        pB = rx > 0 ? ey / rx : 0;
        nrx = rx + ax;
        uint256 ney = (rx * ey) / nrx;
        if (ney <= vy) revert Liq();
        out = ry - (ney - vy);
        if (out == 0 || out > ry) revert Liq();
        pA = ney / nrx;
    }
}

library BTCLib {
    function calc(uint8 dir, uint256 margin, uint256 entry, uint256 notional, uint256 nowP)
        external pure returns (uint256 payout, int256 p, bool liq)
    {
        uint256 diff; bool pos;
        if (dir == 0) {
            if (nowP >= entry) { diff = nowP - entry; pos = true; }
            else { diff = entry - nowP; pos = false; }
        } else {
            if (nowP <= entry) { diff = entry - nowP; pos = true; }
            else { diff = nowP - entry; pos = false; }
        }
        uint256 mag = (notional * diff) / entry;
        p = pos ? int256(mag) : -int256(mag);
        if (p >= 0) payout = margin + uint256(p);
        else {
            uint256 loss = uint256(-p);
            if (loss >= margin) { payout = 0; liq = true; }
            else payout = margin - loss;
        }
    }
}

contract PolygonHybridAMM {
    error Reentrant();
    error OnlyAdmin();
    error ZeroAddr();
    error TransferFail();
    error FeeOnTransfer();
    error StableNotAllowed();
    error AlreadyAllowed();
    error NotAllowed();
    error Need18Dec();
    error OnlyRouter();
    error AlreadyInit();
    error BalanceLow();
    error BadPrice();
    error StaleRound();
    error PriceOld();
    error BadPoolType();
    error NoPool();
    error PoolExists();
    error NeedPoolX1();
    error AmountZero();
    error OnlyStableIn();
    error NotEnoughX();
    error SellExceedsAlloc();
    error BadLeverage();
    error MarginZero();
    error NoPrincipal();
    error MarginExceeds();
    error NoBTCPrice();
    error StaleBTC();
    error AlreadyRedeemed();
    error Closed();
    error NotLiquidatable();
    error Liquidated();
    error NothingToPay();
    error NoLiquidity();
    error BadId();
    error SelfRef();
    error RefAlreadySet();
    error NothingToClaim();
    error NoFee();
    error BadToken();
    error NotEnoughDAI();
    error InversePrice();

    bool private _lock;
    modifier nonReentrant() { if (_lock) revert Reentrant(); _lock = true; _; _lock = false; }
    modifier onlyAdmin()   { if (msg.sender != admin) revert OnlyAdmin(); _; }
    modifier onlyX1(address t) { if (!poolX1[t].exists) revert NoPool(); _; }
    modifier onlyX2(address t) { if (!poolX2[t].exists) revert NoPool(); _; }

    IERC20 public constant USDC = IERC20(0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174);
    IERC20 public constant DAI  = IERC20(0x8f3Cf7ad23Cd3CaDbD9735AFf958023239c6A063);
    AggregatorV3Interface public constant BTC_USD_FEED =
        AggregatorV3Interface(0xc907E116054Ad103354f2D350FD2514433D57F6f);

    uint256 public constant VIRTUAL_RESERVE = 10000 * 10**18;
    uint256 public constant TOTAL_FEE_BPS   = 100;
    uint256 public constant REF_SHARE_BPS   = 5000;
    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOM       = 10000;
    uint256 public constant MAX_LEVERAGE    = 10;
    uint256 public constant MAX_BTC_AGE     = 3600;
    uint256 public constant LIQ_FEE_BPS     = 1000;
    uint256 public constant MAX_LIQ_PER_UPDATE = 300;

    address public immutable admin;
    address public router;
    mapping(address => address) public tokenCreator;

    mapping(address => bool)    public allowedToken;
    mapping(address => address) public referrer;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceUSDC18;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceDAI18;
    uint256 public projectFeeUSDC18;
    uint256 public projectFeeDAI18;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint8 => uint256))) public sellAllocation18;

    struct Pool {
        address tokenX;
        uint256 reserveX;
        uint256 virtualY;
        uint256 realUSDC18;
        uint256 realDAI18;
        bool exists;
    }
    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX1;
    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX2;

    enum Direction { LONG, SHORT }

    struct VirtualBTC {
        Direction direction;
        uint256 margin18;
        uint256 entryPrice18;
        uint256 leverage;
        uint256 notional18;
        uint64  openedAt;
        bool    open;
    }
    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint8 => VirtualBTC[]))) public userBTC;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint8 => uint256))) public userPrincipal18;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint8 => uint256))) public userXReceived;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint8 => bool)))    public userRedeemed;

    struct OpenPosition { address user; address tokenX; uint8 poolType; uint256 posId; }
    OpenPosition[] public openPositions;
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) public positionIndexPlusOne;

    uint256 public btcPrice18;
    uint256 public btcPriceUpdatedAt;

    event PoolCreated(address indexed tokenX, uint256 reserveX, uint256 virtualY, uint8 poolType);
    event SwapExecuted(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, bool isBuy,
        uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOut, uint256 pB, uint256 pA);
    event ReferralSet(address indexed user, address indexed referrer);
    event ReferralReward(address indexed referrer, address indexed user, address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ReferralClaimed(address indexed referrer, uint256 usdcPaid, uint256 daiPaid);
    event ProjectFeeAccrued(address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ProjectFeeWithdrawn(address token, address to, uint256 amount18);
    event TokenAllowed(address indexed token);
    event TokenDisallowed(address indexed token);
    event AllocationIncreased(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 added18, uint256 total18);
    event AllocationUsed(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 spent18, uint256 left18);
    event BTCPriceUpdated(uint256 price18, uint256 updatedAt);
    event VirtualBTCOpened(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType,
        uint256 indexed posId, uint8 direction, uint256 margin18, uint256 leverage, uint256 notional18, uint256 entryPrice18);
    event VirtualBTCLiquidated(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType,
        uint256 indexed posId, uint256 marginLost18, uint256 liquidationFee18);
    event VirtualBTCRedeemed(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType,
        uint256 indexed posId, uint256 payout18, int256 pnl18);
    event RouterUpdated(address indexed router);
    event TokenReceivedFromRouter(address indexed token, address indexed creator,
        uint256 totalAmount, uint256 toX1, uint256 toX2);

    constructor() { admin = msg.sender; }

    function _xfer(IERC20 t, address to, uint256 amt) internal {
        (bool s, bytes memory d) = address(t).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(t.transfer.selector, to, amt));
        if (!s || (d.length != 0 && !abi.decode(d, (bool)))) revert TransferFail();
    }
    function _xferFrom(IERC20 t, address from, address to, uint256 amt) internal {
        (bool s, bytes memory d) = address(t).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(t.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amt));
        if (!s || (d.length != 0 && !abi.decode(d, (bool)))) revert TransferFail();
    }
    function _pullX(address tokenX, address from, uint256 amt) internal {
        uint256 b = IERC20(tokenX).balanceOf(address(this));
        _xferFrom(IERC20(tokenX), from, address(this), amt);
        if (IERC20(tokenX).balanceOf(address(this)) - b != amt) revert FeeOnTransfer();
    }
    function _check18(address token) internal view {
        (bool ok, bytes memory d) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("decimals()"));
        if (!ok || d.length < 32 || abi.decode(d, (uint256)) != 18) revert Need18Dec();
    }

    function allowToken(address t) external onlyAdmin {
        if (t == address(0)) revert ZeroAddr();
        if (t == address(USDC) || t == address(DAI)) revert StableNotAllowed();
        if (allowedToken[t]) revert AlreadyAllowed();
        _check18(t);
        allowedToken[t] = true;
        emit TokenAllowed(t);
    }
    function disallowToken(address t) external onlyAdmin {
        if (!allowedToken[t]) revert NotAllowed();
        allowedToken[t] = false;
        emit TokenDisallowed(t);
    }
    function setRouter(address r) external onlyAdmin {
        if (r == address(0)) revert ZeroAddr();
        router = r;
        emit RouterUpdated(r);
    }

    // --- общий внутренний код создания пулов ---
    function _initPoolX1(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) internal {
        poolX1[tokenX] = Pool(tokenX, amountX, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        emit PoolCreated(tokenX, amountX, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 1);
    }
    function _initPoolX2(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) internal {
        Pool storage p1 = poolX1[tokenX];
        uint256 vy2 = AMMLib.price(p1.reserveX, p1.virtualY, p1.realUSDC18 + p1.realDAI18) * amountX;
        poolX2[tokenX] = Pool(tokenX, amountX, vy2, 0, 0, true);
        emit PoolCreated(tokenX, amountX, vy2, 2);
    }

    function onTokenReceived(address token, address creator, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        if (msg.sender != router) revert OnlyRouter();
        if (token == address(0) || creator == address(0)) revert ZeroAddr();
        if (amount == 0) revert AmountZero();
        if (token == address(USDC) || token == address(DAI)) revert StableNotAllowed();
        if (poolX1[token].exists || poolX2[token].exists) revert AlreadyInit();
        if (!allowedToken[token]) {
            _check18(token);
            allowedToken[token] = true;
            emit TokenAllowed(token);
        }
        tokenCreator[token] = creator;
        if (IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) < amount) revert BalanceLow();

        uint256 toX1 = amount / 2;
        uint256 toX2 = amount - toX1;
        _initPoolX1(token, toX1);
        _initPoolX2(token, toX2);
        emit TokenReceivedFromRouter(token, creator, amount, toX1, toX2);
    }

    function createPoolX1(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant {
        if (!allowedToken[tokenX]) revert NotAllowed();
        if (poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert PoolExists();
        if (amountX == 0) revert AmountZero();
        _pullX(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);
        _initPoolX1(tokenX, amountX);
    }
    function createPoolX2(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant {
        if (!allowedToken[tokenX]) revert NotAllowed();
        if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert NeedPoolX1();
        if (poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert PoolExists();
        if (amountX == 0) revert AmountZero();
        _pullX(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);
        _initPoolX2(tokenX, amountX);
    }

    function buyX1(address t, address tin, uint256 ain) external nonReentrant onlyX1(t) {
        if (!poolX2[t].exists) revert NoPool();
        _buy(t, tin, ain, true);
    }
    function buyX2(address t, address tin, uint256 ain) external nonReentrant onlyX2(t) {
        if (!poolX1[t].exists) revert NoPool();
        _buy(t, tin, ain, false);
    }
    function sellX1(address t, uint256 ax) external nonReentrant onlyX1(t) {
        if (!poolX2[t].exists) revert NoPool();
        _sell(t, ax, true);
    }
    function sellX2(address t, uint256 ax) external nonReentrant onlyX2(t) {
        if (!poolX1[t].exists) revert NoPool();
        _sell(t, ax, false);
    }

    function _buy(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bool useX1) internal {
        if (tokenIn != address(USDC) && tokenIn != address(DAI)) revert OnlyStableIn();
        if (amountIn == 0) revert AmountZero();
        uint8 poolType = useX1 ? 1 : 2;
        Pool storage pool = useX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint256 psB = AMMLib.price(pool.reserveX, pool.virtualY, pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18);

        uint256 amountForPool;
        {
            uint256 totalFee = (amountIn * TOTAL_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOM;
            uint256 refFeeIn = (totalFee * REF_SHARE_BPS) / BPS_DENOM;
            _accrueTradeFees(tokenIn, refFeeIn, totalFee - refFeeIn);
            amountForPool = amountIn - totalFee;
        }

        uint256 out;
        {
            uint256 nrx;
            uint256 pB;
            uint256 pA;
            (out, nrx, pB, pA) = AMMLib.buy(
                pool.reserveX, pool.virtualY, pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18, amountForPool);
            pool.reserveX = nrx;
            emit SwapExecuted(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, true, amountIn, out, pB, pA);
        }

        if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) pool.realUSDC18 += amountForPool;
        else pool.realDAI18 += amountForPool;

        _xferFrom(IERC20(tokenIn), msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
        _xfer(IERC20(tokenX), msg.sender, out);

        _recordBuy(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, amountForPool, out);

        _syncTarget(tokenX, useX1, psB);
    }

    function _sell(address tokenX, uint256 amountX, bool useX1) internal {
        if (amountX == 0) revert AmountZero();
        uint8 poolType = useX1 ? 1 : 2;
        Pool storage pool = useX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (amountX >= pool.reserveX) revert NotEnoughX();
        uint256 psB = AMMLib.price(pool.reserveX, pool.virtualY, pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18);

        uint256 userOut;
        {
            uint256 stableOut;
            uint256 nrx;
            uint256 pB;
            uint256 pA;
            (stableOut, nrx, pB, pA) = AMMLib.sell(
                pool.reserveX, pool.virtualY, pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18, amountX);
            userOut = _chargeSellFees(tokenX, poolType, pool, stableOut);
            pool.reserveX = nrx;
            emit SwapExecuted(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, false, amountX, userOut, pB, pA);
        }

        _pullX(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);
        _payoutStable(pool, msg.sender, userOut);
        _applySellAccounting(tokenX, poolType, amountX);

        _syncTarget(tokenX, useX1, psB);
    }

    function _recordBuy(address user, address tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 amountForPool, uint256 xOut) internal {
        uint256 newAlloc = sellAllocation18[user][tokenX][poolType] + amountForPool;
        sellAllocation18[user][tokenX][poolType] = newAlloc;
        emit AllocationIncreased(user, tokenX, poolType, amountForPool, newAlloc);

        if (userRedeemed[user][tokenX][poolType]) {
            VirtualBTC[] storage old = userBTC[user][tokenX][poolType];
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < old.length; i++) {
                if (old[i].open) {
                    _unregisterOpenPosition(user, tokenX, poolType, i);
                    old[i].open = false;
                }
            }
            delete userBTC[user][tokenX][poolType];
            userRedeemed[user][tokenX][poolType] = false;
            userXReceived[user][tokenX][poolType] = 0;
            userPrincipal18[user][tokenX][poolType] = 0;
        }
        userPrincipal18[user][tokenX][poolType] += amountForPool;
        userXReceived[user][tokenX][poolType]  += xOut;
    }

    function _chargeSellFees(address tokenX, uint8 poolType, Pool storage pool, uint256 stableOut)
        internal returns (uint256 userOut)
    {
        uint256 alloc = sellAllocation18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType];
        if (alloc < stableOut) revert SellExceedsAlloc();
        uint256 newAlloc = alloc - stableOut;
        sellAllocation18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] = newAlloc;
        emit AllocationUsed(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, stableOut, newAlloc);

        uint256 totalFee = (stableOut * TOTAL_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOM;
        uint256 refFee = (totalFee * REF_SHARE_BPS) / BPS_DENOM;
        userOut = stableOut - totalFee;
        _deductSellFees(pool, refFee, totalFee - refFee);
    }

    function _applySellAccounting(address tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 amountX) internal {
        uint256 xRec = userXReceived[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType];
        if (xRec == 0) return;
        uint256 prc = userPrincipal18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType];
        userPrincipal18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] = prc - (prc * amountX) / xRec;
        userXReceived[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType]  = xRec - amountX;
    }

    function updateBTCPrice() external nonReentrant { _readBTC(); _liquidateAll(); }
    function updateBTCPriceOnly() external nonReentrant { _readBTC(); }

    function liquidatePosition(address user, address tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 posId)
        external nonReentrant
    {
        if (poolType != 1 && poolType != 2) revert BadPoolType();
        VirtualBTC storage p = userBTC[user][tokenX][poolType][posId];
        if (!p.open) revert Closed();
        if (btcPrice18 == 0) revert NoBTCPrice();
        (,, bool liq) = BTCLib.calc(uint8(p.direction), p.margin18, p.entryPrice18, p.notional18, btcPrice18);
        if (!liq) revert NotLiquidatable();
        _liquidate(user, tokenX, poolType, posId);
    }

    function _readBTC() internal {
        (uint80 rid, int256 a,, uint256 u, uint80 air) = BTC_USD_FEED.latestRoundData();
        if (a <= 0) revert BadPrice();
        if (u == 0 || air < rid) revert StaleRound();
        if (block.timestamp - u > MAX_BTC_AGE) revert PriceOld();
        uint8 d = BTC_USD_FEED.decimals();
        btcPrice18 = uint256(a) * (10 ** (18 - d));
        btcPriceUpdatedAt = block.timestamp;
        emit BTCPriceUpdated(btcPrice18, block.timestamp);
    }

    function getBTCPrice() public view returns (uint256 price18, uint256 updatedAt) {
        (uint80 rid, int256 a,, uint256 u, uint80 air) = BTC_USD_FEED.latestRoundData();
        if (a <= 0) revert BadPrice();
        if (air < rid) revert StaleRound();
        uint8 d = BTC_USD_FEED.decimals();
        price18 = uint256(a) * (10 ** (18 - d));
        updatedAt = u;
    }

    function _liquidateAll() internal {
        uint256 i = 0; uint256 cnt = 0; uint256 len = openPositions.length;
        while (i < len && cnt < MAX_LIQ_PER_UPDATE) {
            OpenPosition memory op = openPositions[i];
            VirtualBTC storage p = userBTC[op.user][op.tokenX][op.poolType][op.posId];
            if (!p.open) { _removeOpenAt(i); len--; continue; }
            (,, bool liq) = BTCLib.calc(uint8(p.direction), p.margin18, p.entryPrice18, p.notional18, btcPrice18);
            if (liq) {
                _liquidate(op.user, op.tokenX, op.poolType, op.posId);
                _removeOpenAt(i); len--; cnt++;
                continue;
            }
            i++;
        }
    }

    function _liquidate(address user, address tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 posId) internal {
        VirtualBTC storage p = userBTC[user][tokenX][poolType][posId];
        if (!p.open) return;
        Pool storage pool = poolType == 1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint256 margin = p.margin18;
        p.open = false;
        uint256 fee = (margin * LIQ_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOM;
        uint256 avail = pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        if (fee > avail) fee = avail;
        if (fee > 0) {
            (uint256 u, uint256 d) = _deductStable(pool, fee);
            if (u > 0) { projectFeeUSDC18 += u; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), u); }
            if (d > 0) { projectFeeDAI18  += d; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), d); }
        }
        emit VirtualBTCLiquidated(user, tokenX, poolType, posId, margin, fee);
    }

    function _key(address u, address t, uint8 pt, uint256 id) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(u, t, pt, id));
    }
    function _registerOpen(address u, address t, uint8 pt, uint256 id) internal {
        bytes32 k = _key(u, t, pt, id);
        if (positionIndexPlusOne[k] != 0) return;
        openPositions.push(OpenPosition(u, t, pt, id));
        positionIndexPlusOne[k] = openPositions.length;
    }
    function _unregisterOpenPosition(address u, address t, uint8 pt, uint256 id) internal {
        uint256 idxP = positionIndexPlusOne[_key(u, t, pt, id)];
        if (idxP != 0) _removeOpenAt(idxP - 1);
    }
    function _removeOpenAt(uint256 idx) internal {
        OpenPosition memory rem = openPositions[idx];
        delete positionIndexPlusOne[_key(rem.user, rem.tokenX, rem.poolType, rem.posId)];
        uint256 last = openPositions.length - 1;
        if (idx != last) {
            OpenPosition memory lop = openPositions[last];
            openPositions[idx] = lop;
            positionIndexPlusOne[_key(lop.user, lop.tokenX, lop.poolType, lop.posId)] = idx + 1;
        }
        openPositions.pop();
    }

    function openVirtualBTC(address tokenX, uint8 poolType, Direction direction, uint256 margin18, uint256 leverage)
        external nonReentrant
    {
        if (poolType != 1 && poolType != 2) revert BadPoolType();
        Pool storage pool = poolType == 1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (!pool.exists) revert NoPool();
        if (userRedeemed[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType]) revert AlreadyRedeemed();
        if (margin18 == 0) revert MarginZero();
        if (leverage < 1 || leverage > MAX_LEVERAGE) revert BadLeverage();
        uint256 principal = userPrincipal18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType];
        if (principal == 0) revert NoPrincipal();
        if (_usedMargin(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType) + margin18 > principal) revert MarginExceeds();
        (uint256 price18, ) = getBTCPrice();
        if (price18 == 0) revert NoBTCPrice();
        if (block.timestamp - btcPriceUpdatedAt > MAX_BTC_AGE) revert StaleBTC();

        VirtualBTC[] storage arr = userBTC[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType];
        uint256 notional = margin18 * leverage;
        arr.push(VirtualBTC(direction, margin18, price18, leverage, notional,
            uint64(block.timestamp), true));
        uint256 posId = arr.length - 1;
        _registerOpen(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, posId);
        emit VirtualBTCOpened(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, posId, uint8(direction),
            margin18, leverage, notional, price18);
    }

    function _usedMargin(address u, address t, uint8 pt) internal view returns (uint256 used) {
        VirtualBTC[] storage arr = userBTC[u][t][pt];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) if (arr[i].open) used += arr[i].margin18;
    }

    function redeemVirtualBTC(address tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 posId) external nonReentrant {
        if (poolType != 1 && poolType != 2) revert BadPoolType();
        Pool storage pool = poolType == 1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (!pool.exists) revert NoPool();
        if (userRedeemed[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType]) revert AlreadyRedeemed();
        VirtualBTC[] storage arr = userBTC[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType];
        if (posId >= arr.length) revert BadId();
        VirtualBTC storage p = arr[posId];
        if (!p.open) revert Closed();

        (uint256 nowP, ) = getBTCPrice();
        (uint256 payout, , bool liq) = BTCLib.calc(
            uint8(p.direction), p.margin18, p.entryPrice18, p.notional18, nowP);
        if (liq) revert Liquidated();
        if (payout == 0) revert NothingToPay();
        uint256 cap = pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        if (payout > cap) payout = cap;
        if (payout == 0) revert NoLiquidity();

        uint256 xBack = userXReceived[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType];
        if (xBack > 0) {
            _pullX(tokenX, msg.sender, xBack);
            pool.reserveX += xBack;
            userXReceived[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] = 0;
        }
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            if (arr[i].open) {
                _unregisterOpenPosition(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, i);
                arr[i].open = false;
            }
        }
        userRedeemed[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] = true;
        userPrincipal18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] = 0;
        sellAllocation18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] = 0;

        _payoutStable(pool, msg.sender, payout);
        emit VirtualBTCRedeemed(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, posId, payout,
            int256(payout) - int256(p.margin18));
    }

    function setReferrer(address r) external {
        if (r == address(0)) revert ZeroAddr();
        if (r == msg.sender) revert SelfRef();
        if (referrer[msg.sender] != address(0)) revert RefAlreadySet();
        referrer[msg.sender] = r;
        emit ReferralSet(msg.sender, r);
    }

    function claimReferralRewards() external nonReentrant {
        uint256 u = refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender];
        uint256 d = refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender];
        if (u == 0 && d == 0) revert NothingToClaim();
        refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender] = 0;
        refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender] = 0;
        uint256 uPaid = u / 10**12;
        if (uPaid > 0) _xfer(USDC, msg.sender, uPaid);
        if (d > 0) _xfer(DAI, msg.sender, d);
        emit ReferralClaimed(msg.sender, uPaid, d);
    }

    function withdrawProjectFee(address token, address to) external nonReentrant onlyAdmin {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddr();
        if (token == address(USDC)) {
            uint256 a = projectFeeUSDC18; if (a == 0) revert NoFee();
            projectFeeUSDC18 = 0;
            _xfer(USDC, to, a / 10**12);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, a);
        } else if (token == address(DAI)) {
            uint256 a = projectFeeDAI18; if (a == 0) revert NoFee();
            projectFeeDAI18 = 0;
            _xfer(DAI, to, a);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, a);
        } else revert BadToken();
    }

    function _setTarget(address tokenX, bool targetIsX1, uint256 desired) internal {
        Pool storage t = targetIsX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint256 realY = t.realUSDC18 + t.realDAI18;
        uint256 nv = desired * t.reserveX;
        if (nv < realY) revert InversePrice();
        t.virtualY = nv - realY;
    }
    function _syncTarget(address tokenX, bool useX1, uint256 psB) internal {
        if (psB == 0) return;
        Pool storage tgt = useX1 ? poolX2[tokenX] : poolX1[tokenX];
        uint256 ptB = AMMLib.price(tgt.reserveX, tgt.virtualY, tgt.realUSDC18 + tgt.realDAI18);
        if (ptB == 0) return;
        Pool storage src = useX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint256 psa = AMMLib.price(src.reserveX, src.virtualY, src.realUSDC18 + src.realDAI18);
        if (psa == 0) return;
        _setTarget(tokenX, !useX1, (ptB * psB) / psa);
    }

    function _payoutStable(Pool storage pool, address user, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 u = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (amount <= u) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = u - amount;
            _xfer(USDC, user, amount / 10**12);
        } else {
            pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
            _xfer(USDC, user, u / 10**12);
            uint256 r = amount - u;
            if (pool.realDAI18 < r) revert NotEnoughDAI();
            pool.realDAI18 -= r;
            _xfer(DAI, user, r);
        }
    }

    function _deductStable(Pool storage pool, uint256 amount)
        internal returns (uint256 u, uint256 d)
    {
        uint256 pu = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (amount <= pu) { pool.realUSDC18 = pu - amount; return (amount, 0); }
        pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
        uint256 r = amount - pu;
        if (pool.realDAI18 < r) revert NotEnoughDAI();
        pool.realDAI18 -= r;
        return (pu, r);
    }

    function _accrueTradeFees(address tokenIn, uint256 refFee, uint256 projFee) internal {
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];
        if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) {
            if (projFee > 0) {
                uint256 pf = projFee * 10**12;
                projectFeeUSDC18 += pf;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), pf);
            }
            if (refFee > 0) {
                uint256 rf = refFee * 10**12;
                if (ref != address(0)) {
                    refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += rf;
                    emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), rf);
                } else {
                    projectFeeUSDC18 += rf;
                    emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), rf);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (projFee > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += projFee;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), projFee);
            }
            if (refFee > 0) {
                if (ref != address(0)) {
                    refBalanceDAI18[ref] += refFee;
                    emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), refFee);
                } else {
                    projectFeeDAI18 += refFee;
                    emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), refFee);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function _deductSellFees(Pool storage pool, uint256 refFee, uint256 projFee) internal {
        if (projFee > 0) {
            (uint256 pu, uint256 pd) = _deductStable(pool, projFee);
            if (pu > 0) { projectFeeUSDC18 += pu; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), pu); }
            if (pd > 0) { projectFeeDAI18  += pd; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), pd); }
        }
        if (refFee == 0) return;
        (uint256 ru, uint256 rd) = _deductStable(pool, refFee);
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];
        if (ref != address(0)) {
            if (ru > 0) { refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += ru; emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), ru); }
            if (rd > 0) { refBalanceDAI18[ref]  += rd; emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), rd); }
        } else {
            if (ru > 0) { projectFeeUSDC18 += ru; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), ru); }
            if (rd > 0) { projectFeeDAI18  += rd; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), rd); }
        }
    }
}
